The verbs that take a list apart or build one from a map. first and last answer the element at either end as a document of its own, and nothing for an empty list. slice answers the elements between two indices numbered from 0, and takes what there is when the range runs past the end. sum adds whole numbers in the shell and answers an int, and adds in awk and answers a float when any element has a fraction. values answers a map's values as a list, and entries answers one map of key and value per member. line writes a document on one line and reads it back. Each verb refuses a document of the wrong kind, and slice refuses an index that is not a whole number.
